remarks: Located in the pulse of the beautiful + sophisticated town of Darien, you'll delight in this immaculate, spacious 1-Bedroom/1-Bath where you'll enjoy walking to popular shops, restaurants the metro north train station, and parks! This apartment offers hardwood floors throughout, excellent closet space, a pretty, newer kitchen + sparkling bath, 1- off-street parking space and washer/dryer across the hall. Come see the possibilities here and enjoy living in the heart of Darien's many vibrant attractions!
